title: Claude Code — Members & Sessions
description: Per-member and per-session view. Requires team agreement: see the README privacy notes.

list.name: data_source
list.label: Data source
list.description: transcript: derived from local transcripts. real-otel: Claude Code's own OTel, which carries no data_source label (matches the empty label). all: both, which double counts a machine that exports both. The built-in All (URL value $__all, kept so old bookmarks work) is the same as all (may double count). The Budget dashboard always excludes synthetic and transcript-fixture, so those two options leave its panels empty.
list.query: transcript : transcript, real-otel : ^$, all (may double count) : .*, synthetic : synthetic, transcript-fixture : transcript-fixture

panels.title: Cost by member (USD)
panels.description: Per-user view. Transcript data uses the user label set with --user; real OTel joins user.email from target_info (last value over the range) on job and instance. If two emails share a job and instance, one of them is picked and gets both people's usage (unverified against real data).

targets.expr: sort_desc((sum by (user) ((last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user!=""}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user!=""}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user!=""}[$__range]) * 0) * (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user!=""}[$__range]) >= bool (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user!=""}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user!=""}[$__range]) * 0)))) or sum by (user) (label_replace(sum by (user_email) (sum by (job, instance) ((last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user=""}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user=""}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user=""}[$__range]) * 0) * (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user=""}[$__range]) >= bool (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user=""}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source=~"$data_source",user=""}[$__range]) * 0)))) * on (job, instance) group_left (user_email) topk by (job, instance) (1, max by (job, instance, user_email) (last_over_time(target_info{user_email!=""}[$__range])))), "user", "$1", "user_email", "(.*)"))))

panels.title: Tool failure rate by member
panels.description: Share of tool_result events with success=false, per user.id attribute. Real OTel logs may carry the user under another attribute name (unverified).

targets.expr: sort_desc(avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "tool_result" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | label_format failed=`{{ if eq .success "false" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap failed [$__range]) by (user_id))

panels.title: Top sessions by cost
panels.description: session_id is queried from Loki logs and limited to the top N; it is never a metric label. Needs cost_usd on api_request (transcripts need ccline pricing).

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (session_id, user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | cost_usd != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.title: Top sessions by context growth
panels.description: Peak and lowest context per session, growth as the difference, and peak share of the model window. Top N by peak context.

targets.expr: topk($topn, max by (session_id, user_id) (max_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_tokens != "" | unwrap context_tokens [$__range])))
min by (session_id) (min_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_tokens != "" | unwrap context_tokens [$__range]))
max by (session_id) (max_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_pct != "" | unwrap context_pct [$__range]))

panels.title: Sessions with context drops (top N)
panels.description: Sessions where the context fell sharply between consecutive requests, which usually means a compaction.

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (session_id, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_drop = "true" [$__range])))
topk(20, sum by (prompt_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "tool_result" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | success = "false" [$__range])))

panels.title: Repeated path-based tool calls per prompt_id

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (prompt_id, tool_name, tool_parameters) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "tool_result" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | tool_parameters != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Trace explorer: claude_code.interaction
panels.description: Transcript spans carry data_source; real OTel spans have no such attribute, so the query treats a missing attribute as empty, the same way the Prometheus and Loki panels do.
